name: The lich in Scholomance

date.label: Classic quest sequence; in-world date unknown

summary: Quest 5466 directs the seeker to find Ras Frostwhisper in Scholomance and use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead form.
description: The final quest sends the seeker into Scholomance to find Ras Frostwhisper. The old academy’s cold halls frame an encounter with the lich who once chose undeath. No traveling route is drawn across this scene: the dungeon is its own enclosed setting, and the illustration offers no measured floor plan. The keepsake is brought close enough to be used against Ras’s undead form.
